title: Collect overdue invoices and resolve bad debt
summary: When an issued business invoice is overdue or its payment is disputed. Each overdue balance has a documented resolution, next collection action or approved accounting treatment.
outcomes: Each overdue balance has a documented resolution, next collection action or approved accounting treatment.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When an issued business invoice is overdue or its payment is disputed.

parts.title: Reconcile the receivable and evidence
parts.guidance: Match the signed terms, invoice, delivery evidence, credits and bank receipts. Confirm the correct debtor, due date and amount, and distinguish an actual dispute from a missing invoice or processing error.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Choose a proportionate recovery approach
parts.guidance: The account owner reviews the customer relationship and finance exposure. Counsel confirms applicable collection rules and any proposed charges, demand, settlement or enforcement; do not apply one country's interest rules globally.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Contact the debtor through the approved channel
parts.guidance: Send the authorized reminder or arrange a discussion using verified billing contacts. Ask for the dispute basis or payment commitment and record responses without threatening unapproved legal action.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Contact the debtor through the approved channel

parts.title: Approve escalation or a payment arrangement
parts.guidance: Review the documented response, recovery cost and the customer's ability to pay. Obtain authority for revised terms, service restrictions, collection-agent referral or proceedings and keep those actions within contract and local rules.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve escalation or a payment arrangement

parts.title: Apply receipts or approved loss treatment
parts.guidance: Reconcile payments and approved credits to the ledger. Have the accountant determine any allowance or write-off, preserve recovery evidence and assign an owner and date for unresolved balances.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: Each overdue balance has a documented resolution, next collection action or approved accounting treatment.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting.
